channel.title: Japan Sourcing and Market Entry Guides | GuideTech Japan Partner
channel.description: Practical guides from Tokyo on finding and verifying Japanese suppliers, and on sourcing matcha, trading cards, skincare and confectionery from Japan.

item.title: How to Find Japanese Suppliers
item.description: The five sourcing channels that work in Japan, why most wholesale routes are closed to foreign buyers, and how to verify a company before you pay.

item.title: How to Find a Matcha Supplier in Japan
item.description: Growing regions, the four supplier types, what ceremonial grade really means, the tencha shortage, and the certificates to demand before ordering.

item.title: Japanese Trading Card Wholesale Explained
item.description: Why overseas buyers cannot open a Japanese TCG wholesale account, what distributors require, how allocation works, and the lawful routes in.

item.title: Japanese Skincare Sourcing: Wholesale vs OEM
item.description: Authorised wholesale, the risks of parallel import, and OEM private label in Japan: licences, minimums, lead times and destination compliance.

item.title: Japanese Snack and Confectionery Wholesale
item.description: Japan's distribution layers, the shelf-life mathematics that catches new importers, and the allergen and additive rules your market will apply.

item.title: How to Verify a Japanese Company
item.description: Check a Japanese supplier with public records: the free corporate register, the commercial register extract, credit reports and safe payment terms.

item.title: Japanese Kitchen Knives Wholesale Guide
item.description: The four production regions, forged versus stamped, the steel families, realistic minimums, and the export rules that catch new importers.

item.title: Sourcing at Japanese Trade Shows
item.description: Which Japanese trade shows matter by category, how to build a target list, why follow-up decides the outcome, and how proxy attendance works.

item.title: Japanese Translation Price Guide
item.description: What a per-word Japanese quote covers, where software work leaves the word rate behind, what actually drives the number, and how to compare quotes.

item.title: Software Localization Japan Guide
item.description: Localizing software for Japan: working from product context, choosing a register, local formats, LINE and invoice expectations, and in-interface QA.

item.title: Translation Agency vs Localization Partner
item.description: What a Japanese translation agency is built to do well, the decisions it cannot make for you, and when a localization partner is the right purchase instead.

item.title: Doing Business in Japan: First 90 Days
item.description: A first-90-days guide for overseas software companies entering Japan without a local office: trust, the buying process, realistic sequencing and what not to build yet.
